test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-5) Official Paper (Held On: 15 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Poompuhar beach located in the state of Tamil Nadu along the Bay of Bengal is famous for the _________ festival.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chitra Pournami**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Poompuhar Beach**

 
 
• The natural and historic **Poompuhar Beach** is situated along the **Bay of Bengal in Poompuhar, Tamil Nadu, India**.
 
• The beach begins at the** Kaveri River and stretches 3 kilometres** northward toward **Neithavasal**. 
 
• **South Indian history **is very important to this beach and the city of Poompuhar.
 
• A significant celebration for this beach is called **Chitra Pournami**, and it takes place in the **Tamil month of Chittrai at the full moon**.
 
• During the new moon **in the Tamil months of Thai and Adi**, **a holy dip is also observed near the mouth of the Kaveri River**. 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• This **beach's sand** extends for around **three kilometres**.
 
• To **avoid erosion**, granite stones have just been added to the shore.
 
• The closest town, **Mayiladuthurai, is about 24 kilometres** away from this beach and is situated on the **bank of the Kaveri River**.
 
• An **engraved monument is another attraction** near Poompuhar Beach in addition to Chitra Pournami.
 
• The **Silappathikara Art Gallery** is another one, and it provides information about the **area's past**. 
 
• The** Zion Church and the Thiruppallavaneeswaram Temple**, both of which are close to Poompuhar Beach, should also be visited.
